scope: Proposition 3.1 (Macroscopic exponential moments) of the manuscript “Uniform real Lipschitz surfaces on the triangular lattice” (preprints/Uniform-real-Lipschitz-surfaces-on-the-triangular-lattice-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 232 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce5ae39087f446a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix c, C > 0 and B < ∞. Let R ≥ 1 and let deterministic real weights qx obey ∑︂ x |qx| ≤ C, max x |qx| ≤ CR−2 , supp q ⊂ Q, diam Q ≤ CR, (3.1) where Q is an ambient coordinate box. Assume either ∑︁ x qx = 0, or there is a connected set of pins K, of diameter at least cR, such that K ∪ Q lies in a coordinate box of diameter at most CR. For a sample h from µb, there are a > 0 and M < ∞, depending only on c, C, B, such that E exp (︄ a ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ∑︂ x qxh(x) ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ ⃓ )︄ ≤ M. (3.2) The conclusion is uniform over mixtures of bounded pin values whenever conditioning on those values leaves exactly the specified uniform law.
